questions.stem: Convert to indirect speech: He said, 'I am busy.'

options.option_text: He said that he is busy.
He said that I was busy.
He said that he was busy.
He says that he was busy.

questions.explanation: Present → past and 'I' → 'he'. **Short Trick:** past reporting verb backshifts the tense.

questions.stem: Convert to indirect speech: She said, 'I will come tomorrow.'

options.option_text: She said that she will come tomorrow.
She said that she would come tomorrow.
She said she will come the next day.
She said that she would come the next day.

questions.explanation: will → would; tomorrow → the next day. **Short Trick:** shift both the modal and the time word.

questions.stem: Convert to indirect speech: He said to me, 'Where are you going?'

options.option_text: He asked me where I am going.
He asked me where was I going.
He asked me where I was going.
He said me where I was going.

questions.explanation: Question → 'asked'; no inversion; tense backshifts. **Short Trick:** in reported questions keep normal word order.

questions.stem: Convert to indirect speech: She said, 'What a beautiful flower!'

options.option_text: She said that it was a beautiful flower.
She exclaimed that it was a very beautiful flower.
She exclaimed what a beautiful flower it was.
She told that the flower was beautiful.

questions.explanation: Exclamatory → 'exclaimed that' + assertive form. **Short Trick:** exclamations become 'exclaimed with joy/sorrow that …'.

questions.stem: Convert to indirect speech: He said, 'Please help me.'

options.option_text: He said to help him.
He requested me to help him.
He asked me help him.
He ordered me to help him.

questions.explanation: Request → 'requested' + to-infinitive. **Short Trick:** requests → requested + to + base verb.

questions.stem: Convert to indirect speech: The teacher said to the students, 'Sit down.'

options.option_text: The teacher said to sit down.
The teacher ordered the students to sit down.
The teacher asked to sit down.
The teacher told to sit down.

questions.explanation: Command → 'ordered/told' + object + to-infinitive. **Short Trick:** commands → ordered + object + to.

questions.stem: Convert to indirect speech: He said, 'I bought a car yesterday.'

options.option_text: He said that he had bought a car the previous day.
He said that he bought a car yesterday.
He said that he had bought a car yesterday.
He said he has bought a car the previous day.

questions.explanation: Past simple → past perfect; yesterday → the previous day. **Short Trick:** V2 becomes had + V3.

questions.stem: Convert to indirect speech: She said, 'I can swim.'

options.option_text: She said that she can swim.
She said that she will swim.
She said she could swims.
She said that she could swim.

questions.explanation: can → could. **Short Trick:** can→could, may→might, must→had to.

questions.stem: Convert to indirect speech: He said, 'Let us go for a walk.'

options.option_text: He said to go for a walk.
He suggested that they should go for a walk.
He asked to go for a walk.
He told them to go for a walk.

questions.explanation: 'Let us' (proposal) → 'suggested/proposed that … should'. **Short Trick:** let us → suggested that + should.

questions.stem: Convert to indirect speech: She said, 'I may attend the party.'

options.option_text: She said that she may attend the party.
She said that she might attend the party.
She said she might attends the party.
She said that she can attend the party.

questions.explanation: may → might. **Short Trick:** may becomes might in reported speech.
